notes: Stories refined for clearer contract boundaries, fallback determinism, and explicit integration behavior. No new stories added to avoid duplication.

change_log.value: Clarified deterministic response contract including relevance score normalization, attribution fields (vector vs taxonomy), and strict pagination invariants.
Explicit fallback triggers defined (score threshold + result count) and enforced deterministic ranking order across vector and taxonomy paths.
Added requirement that specialty resolution outputs must be traceable and passed as explicit NUCC inputs into provider search with no hidden inference.
Clarified tool_router allowlist enforcement and added requirement for structured error taxonomy (validation vs search vs system errors).
Expanded test scope to include deterministic replay tests and fallback path verification under controlled embedding degradation scenarios.
change_log.note: Close gap in test determinism and resilience validation
